name: path-rehearsal
description: A deterministic live rehearsal of the goal paths no research run has reached: a flat world laid out by console commands, six real bodies, and the scripted path exerciser. Not a research run and never published.
layout: Six groups far enough apart that only beta hears zeta's speech (24 blocks): alpha beside a three-log trunk; beta three blocks from one log, whose drop lands outside the pickup box and is left lying, with zeta four blocks off; gamma four blocks from delta, who stands on a stick vanilla may not pick up for 450 ticks; epsilon beside one log and a log item no one may pick up that despawns about 500 ticks after it is summoned, with another log twelve blocks east past what it senses; theta stands on a stick vanilla may not pick up for 1100 ticks, on a stone pad that gives a bare hand nothing, so its met goal is completed plainly and owes a review; eta stands on grass beside a pocket under an overhang, the block east of its support with stone two above it, with a three-log trunk 3.2 blocks off, so its dirt goal is refused beside the frontier and its log goal is restated and completed beside a log; iota stands at 43.357 in a one-cell pit, its only standable cell, beside a one-high nook east whose dirt lies at 44.863, 0.08 past vanilla's pickup box from where iota stands, as r28 rehearsal alpha's did at tick 9765; kappa stands with its box against the north face of the 128-block world border at z -64, 3.2 blocks north of a creeper that cannot move, so its flight must run along the border rather than over it, as v29 rehearsal theta's flights from a skeleton did not; on an easy world that keeps hostile mobs but spawns none (the doMobSpawning gamerule is off); Bukkit's monster spawn limit is zero from the first tick, because superflat ground lies below y 40, where slimes spawn in any light.
